providers.name: DataFluxor FUT Data

provider_description.contract: GET /api/v1/fut/prices?ea_ids=comma-separated-EA-item-IDs&platform=pc; POST same read with rating/rarity_id/club_id hints. Browse /api/v1/fut/cards?market=pc; history /api/v1/fut/cards/{futbin_id}/history?market=pc&period=30d.
provider_description.identity: ea_id is full EA card version; player_id is base player, futbin_id is site catalogue ID; ea_id=0 is unresolved. Verify hints and reject ambiguous/mismatching mappings.
provider_description.price_meaning: Lowest buy-now listing in coins; card/list source is newest stored read. Zero means no listing on latest read, not a zero-coin executable ask. Recent sales are separate fields with unverified provenance.
provider_description.access: Active FUT Data subscription and X-API-Key (or documented Bearer key); ordinary anonymous production GET returned 401. Free general credits do not grant FUT production access. Fixed sandbox needs no key, account or payment.
provider_description.terms: API results permitted inside own products subject to terms; raw service/API resale needs written agreement. Data as-is and delayed; user remains responsible for EA terms. Paid access starts with charge; individual complimentary access can be arranged. No trial or purchase initiated.

unknowns: Production exact IDs and prices against EA
Real refresh distribution and upstream observation latency
Production history completeness and source rights beyond provider descriptions
Concurrency queue behavior: page says waits up to 20 seconds; OpenAPI describes refusal

fallback.source: Existing authenticated official EA Web App search via retained local read-only bridge
fallback.native_identity: itemData.resourceId -> definition_id; physical itemData.id and tradeId stay distinct and are pseudonymized per run
preconditions: fresh authenticated FC27 PC network GET, not cached 304
freeze protocol hash before new observation
fallback.price_meaning: Conservative lower-tail estimate of sampled active BIN asks for the exact version on PC, excluding candidate trade/item. Not completed-sale price or full-market lowest ask.
fallback.freshness: Retain command/native/network/receive UTC, expires, BIN, bid/state; cache-only snapshots do not refresh freshness. Follow protocol reference/candidate age limits and fresh read-only revalidation.
fallback.history: Only retained local samples; no broad retrospective history or full-market timeseries
fallback.missing_prices: UNKNOWN; no borrowing across versions, platforms or games; insufficient independent comparables => no priced opportunity
fallback.missing_rules: Diagnostic-only estimate if caps/increments/tradability or tax assumptions remain unverified; no executable yield
stops: 429/5xx/timeout follow protocol backoff within remaining budget
no retry after third-party 403 until legitimate access
limits: Expiry-ordered moving pages overlap and truncate; 20 visible rows plus lookahead are not exhaustive
Only sampled versions and selected price bands/filters, no market-wide card coverage or sell-through guarantee
Historical counts are not current FC27 attachment or a T2 live benchmark
Provider snapshot remains unavailable for all A/B/C strategies; freeze equal explicit unavailable status per block
